_about: v79.14.1 (item 1): a party's side read from the role word the extraction gives it (data the role_flip check and the client-on-the-intake's-side fix read: src/rag/interactive_flow.py:party_side). The procedural role words first (intake._ROLE_WORDS: imputato, persona offesa, parte civile, attore, convenuto -- intake.side_of), then these: «accused» -- the side that resists a demand, a charge or a claim; «victim» -- the side that claims or complains. A party whose words say neither has no side (never guessed). A party demanding something and threatening to sue (intake.threat_parties) is on the «victim» side whatever its word.
